instruction: Look at freecad_task-18_input.step in FreeCAD. Use the Part Design workbench throughout; activate the Body, create new sketches on the required faces or planes, and complete all fused features in the same Body using GUI additive and subtractive features. Create a radial fan grille from the square plate while keeping the 120 x 120 x 6 mm outside envelope. Cut a centered circular through opening of diameter 34 mm at (60,60). Cut sixteen radial through slots, each exactly 28 mm long radially and 4 mm wide tangentially, starting at radius 28 mm and ending at radius 56 mm from the center; place the first slot on +X and pattern the rest every 22.5 degrees. Cut four corner mounting holes of diameter 8 mm at (15,15), (105,15), (15,105), and (105,105). Export /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-18_output.step using the FreeCAD GUI only; external script files are forbidden.
